user_query: I'm a teacher and I want to make my online classes more fun and engaging for my students. Can you recommend some popular sticker packs that I can use during the classes? Also, suggest an API that I can use to send reminders and announcements to the students.

TaskList.description: Research and compile a list of popular sticker packs suitable for online classes.
Identify and choose an API for sending reminders and announcements to students.
Integrate the selected sticker packs into the online teaching platform.
Set up the chosen API to send reminders and announcements to students.
